classification_rationale: No sufficiently clear single-command configuration-only pattern was identified; human review is required.
source_check_text:
Review the switch configurations and verify that no access switch ports have been assigned membership to the default VLAN (i.e., VLAN 1). VLAN assignments can be verified via the show vlan command:

SW1#show vlan

VLAN Name Status Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -------------------------------
1 default active
10 User VLAN active Gi0/3, Gi1/0, Gi1/1, Gi1/2
Gi1/3, Gi2/1
20 Management VLAN active Gi0/2
999 VLAN0999 active Gi2/0

If access switch ports are assigned to the default VLAN, this is a finding.
source_fix_text: Remove the assignment of the default VLAN from all access switch ports.
title: The Cisco switch must not have the default VLAN assigned to any host-facing switch ports.
